question: Who among the following became the 49th Chief Justice of India in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Umesh Lalit.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uday Umesh Lalit **became the** 49th Chief Justice of India** in **August 2022.**
 
• It is important to note that the Chief Justice of India is the** highest-ranking judicial officer** in the country and is responsible for the** administration of justice **and the **functioning of the judiciary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fali Sam Nariman** is a renowned **Indian jurist and senior advocate** who has served as the** Solicitor General of India** and was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan in 2007.**
 
• **Gopal Subramaniam** is a senior advocate and former** Solicitor General of India **who has also served as a judge of the **Madras High Court** and the **Delhi High Court.**
 
• **Mukul Rohatgi** is a** senior advocate** who has served as the **Attorney General of India** and has represented the Government of India in various high-profile__ cases.
